proposed_event_model.purpose: Identify a run and its declared route before work begins.
Record terminal successful or qualified completion and aggregate timings.
Record a terminal failure without converting it to success.
Make mesh counts, quality status and input digest available before assembly.
Start an assembly timing scope.
Close assembly timing and report matrix/operator size where available.
Declare one linear system dispatch and its requested method/preconditioner.
Observe iterative progress when the backend exposes a reliable callback.
Record convergence, final residual/backward error, iterations, fallback and elapsed time.
Start a nonlinear, dynamic or continuation step.

Report residual, correction, line-search summary, linear diagnostics and resource samples.

Record the accepted trial factor.
Record a rejected trial and its reason.
Record durable accepted-state persistence and its digest.
Report active contacts and contact-state transitions without embedding contact physics in the sink.
Start a physical-time increment and declare dt.
Record accepted time integration and energy/residual summaries.
Expose rejected time increments and retry reason.
Publish each accepted eigenpair and residual quality.

field_types.sequence_number: non-negative integer, strictly increasing per analysis stream
field_types.elapsed_time_s: finite monotonic clock value in seconds
field_types.status: RUNNING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, COMPLETED, FAILED, or DEGRADED
field_types.metrics: object; numeric values finite or represented by null plus metric_status/reason
field_types.metadata: object; no matrices, state arrays or unbounded payloads

rules: timestamp_utc is provenance context and is not used as a deterministic comparison key; elapsed_time_s and sequence_number are the ordering keys.
Missing or not-computable metrics are explicit nulls with a reason; zero is never used as an availability sentinel.
All numeric payloads are finite before serialization; NaN and Infinity are rejected, never emitted.
The envelope carries digests and bounded summaries, not full state vectors or matrices.
Each analysis has one writer/sequence domain; MPI aggregation is outside the mechanics path and must preserve rank provenance.
Legacy WP04 payloads remain available through a compatibility wrapper until their consumers migrate.

analysis_coverage_matrix.current_state: Result/audit and large benchmark telemetry exist; no common live observer.
ModalResult and solver diagnostics report modes and residuals; no event producer.
Fixed full-Newton WP04 helper has an opt-in legacy observer; adaptive helper forwarding and common lifecycle are incomplete.
Nonlinear state/checkpoint/result diagnostics exist, but public NonlinearStaticSolver has no telemetry observer.
Contact diagnostics are route/result specific; no generic contact observer.
Arc-length diagnostics and checkpoint metadata exist, but no common live observer.
Newmark history and checkpoint contracts exist; no common live observer.
HarmonicResult carries frequency rows and solver diagnostics; no common event producer.

policy: method and backend are separate fields
iteration metrics are optional only when the backend cannot expose them

a failed solve cannot emit a successful LINEAR_SOLVE_END

memory_schema.peak_rss_process: OS/process high-water resident set for the measured process scope; not a sum unless explicitly labelled as a rank aggregate.
memory_schema.peak_private_or_uss_process: OS/process high-water private or USS memory for the measured process scope; null with availability reason when the platform cannot measure it.
memory_schema.telemetry_sample_peak_rss: Maximum of RSS values sampled at emitted events/checkpoints in the declared observation window; not necessarily the OS high-water mark.
memory_schema.telemetry_sample_peak_private: Maximum of private/USS values sampled at emitted events/checkpoints in the declared observation window; never inferred from RSS.
memory_schema.existing_mapping: core/nonlinear/telemetry.process_memory_bytes provides a point RSS plus USS/private when psutil is available; large/memory.process_memory_snapshot provides current and peak RSS, with platform source, but no private/USS.
memory_schema.aggregation: For MPI, preserve per-rank values, peak-per-rank and sum-of-rank peaks as distinct fields; never call the sum a process peak.

timing_schema.existing_mapping: observatory phase names are model_setup, preflight, assembly_operator, redistribution, pc_setup, ksp_solve, communication, io, post_processing and total; WP04 nonlinear records use assembly_time_s, linear_solve_time_s, iteration_wall_time_s and step_wall_time_s.
rules: Do not use an ambiguous time or elapsed field when a phase field is available.
Nested scopes must not be summed as though independent; total_analysis_seconds is wall time for the complete analysis.
Telemetry I/O is reported separately and does not become mechanics time by implication.

jsonl_policy.format: one UTF-8 JSON object per line
jsonl_policy.append_safe: single writer per stream; MPI uses independent rank streams or an explicitly coordinated aggregator
jsonl_policy.flush: immediate flush after each event, preserving already written history after abort
jsonl_policy.sequence: strictly increasing per analysis stream; gaps are detectable and must be reported by the reader
jsonl_policy.schema: every line carries schema_version and event_type
jsonl_policy.finite_values: allow_nan=false plus pre-serialization finite validation; non-computable metrics use null and reason
jsonl_policy.fsync: optional policy, off by default to avoid unmeasured overhead; enable at terminal/checkpoint events for a durability-qualified run
jsonl_policy.sink_failure: mark sink DEGRADED, issue a secondary warning/diagnostic, stop writing that sink safely, and preserve the original mechanics result or exception; never fabricate a terminal PASS
jsonl_policy.crash_abort: already flushed lines remain valid history; an absent terminal event means INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN, not success
jsonl_policy.compatibility: retain legacy WP04 JSONL fields during migration and add a versioned adapter rather than changing C2R6 output in place

console_monitor_design.mode: text-only opt-in, rate-limited by event or wall-clock interval
behavior: single concise line for progress, a structured terminal line for success/failure
no GUI and no solver decision based on console rendering
redact paths/secrets and bound message length
stderr or logger fallback on console sink failure

failure_safety_policy.behavior: best-effort ANALYSIS_FAILED with error type/code and last finite metrics; re-raise/preserve the original exception
best-effort interrupted marker; re-raise KeyboardInterrupt and do not relabel as completed
emit FAILED terminal status with last finite residual/history and explicit reason; no success event
fail closed, do not serialize NaN/Infinity, use null plus NOT_COMPUTABLE/NONFINITE reason only where the failure contract permits it
isolate sink failure from mechanics, mark DEGRADED out of band, preserve the solver result/exception, and expose loss of telemetry

failure_safety_policy.condition: disk full or file write error
failure_safety_policy.behavior: same degraded sink path; never swallow the original solver exception and never convert missing terminal telemetry into PASS

overhead_contract.monitoring_disabled: fast path with no event construction, no memory sampling and no sink calls beyond a cheap disabled check; current driver does not fully meet this because it samples memory around iteration emissions even when no observer is installed.
overhead_contract.monitoring_enabled: bounded overhead to be measured per route and sink; no percentage is frozen by this preparation artifact.
benchmark_controls: separate telemetry I/O and solver timings
report median and tail as well as event count and file size
repeat on at least one nonlinear and one large linear route before freezing a budget
overhead_contract.qualification_rule: Owner approves a measured per-route budget after the benchmark; a budget cannot be claimed from the current prototype.

compatibility_plan.reason: Keep the callable alias and adapt legacy mappings into the common envelope.
Preserve append/flush and C2R6 payloads; add a future sink health/sequence layer outside the legacy writer.
Retain failure isolation, but expose sink degradation instead of silently losing all diagnostics.
Emit legacy event names unchanged while a route adapter emits generic events.
Do not break the MPI assembly campaign; map it later through an adapter.
Keep platform probes and add explicit normalized names only at the observer boundary.
Use as terminal evidence/provenance validation and rank aggregation, not as a live sink.
Map existing fields to LINEAR_SOLVE_* without forcing one backend or exception type.
Publish lifecycle/checkpoint events while keeping state and file formats unchanged.
No migration during preparation; C2R6 output compatibility is a hard constraint.
